risks.rationale: The confirmed privacy compromise has its own operator-controlled verdict.
risks.condition: Report the incident state verbatim and keep P-001 through P-003 open until the operator decides them.

risks.rationale: Reachable private and runtime history belongs to the confirmed privacy incident.
risks.condition: Do not rewrite history or delete data without explicit operator authorization.

risks.rationale: Incomplete disputed-commit disposition makes the baseline unverifiable.
An unreproducible clean installation invalidates the Gate 0 baseline.
False-green or incomplete test discovery invalidates Gate 0 evidence.
Unclassified deterministic release failures invalidate the measured baseline.
Untruthful baseline documentation invalidates the handoff state.
Generated E2E material must not reintroduce private data into the candidate tree.
The Local Validation ref is required when the T5 runner is audited, not for the deterministic Gate 0 scope.
risks.condition: Fetch and verify the exact frozen ref before Gate 4 T5 evidence; never substitute another commit.

risks.rationale: Repository visibility is an operator-owned privacy containment decision.
risks.condition: Keep the current tree contained and report repository visibility until P-001 is decided.

risks.rationale: A runner that writes raw transcripts into the tracked tree cannot produce trustworthy evidence.
An implicit database import path can touch operator data during an unwrapped test run.
Filename-based test omission is a Gate 0 registry-integrity failure.
Direct-run filesystem and database isolation is repository-local; its closed state remains monitored and reopening it must block Gate 0.
The producing process cannot give final independent acceptance to its own evidence.
risks.condition: A bounded read-only reviewer must reproduce or audit the exact candidate packet before PASS.

risks.rationale: An incomplete false-green inventory invalidates test-trust claims.
A regression that strips the restored product documentation would again be a repository-local Gate 0 finding.
The remote security boundary is an explicitly separate post-Gate-0 track.
risks.condition: The legacy listener must remain loopback-only; off-loopback binding is prohibited until the separate authenticated boundary and bypass-negative tests pass.

risks.rationale: Milestone success output after generation or test-gate failure is a repository-local test-trust defect.
A regression to generic GPU metadata would again hide the exact model, context, VRAM, residency, and concurrency prerequisite.
Misclassified model-backed soak programs invalidate deterministic scope selection.
A test process that exits zero after named failures is a Gate 0 false-green defect.
A broken refinement path cannot be hidden behind a successful primary response.
An insecure server coordination file prevents the owned runner from starting truthfully.
A provider outage represented as a successful persisted assistant turn is a Gate 0 test-trust defect.
A route factory exception ignored by its registered smoke suite is a Gate 0 false-green defect.
A vulnerability-audit network or process failure represented as a clean report is a Gate 0 false-green defect.
Caller-controlled or weakly bound evidence provenance can create a false Gate 0 attestation.
A required offline suite that depends on live GPU discovery invalidates deterministic Gate 0 evidence.
Media render lifecycle scheduling is a product-capability acceptance concern rather than a Gate 0 measurement-integrity defect.
risks.condition: Keep failed media-output retries bounded by the per-cache 60-second and 256-entry contract; C3-001 cannot pass Gate 1 until health-request cadence and timer teardown are repaired and tested.

risks.rationale: A promotion writer that rejects every valid four-output result makes the locked review-to-PASS evidence chain unreproducible.
